'''Markren Pellias''' was the [[Planetary Trade Director]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] begin to conscript the husbands, brothers, and sons of Rhamalai, Pellias argued with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros]] that it was unfair. Yrros told him they were sufficiently compensated, and went on to tell Pellias that Rhamalai was now under Imperial control, and would serve as an [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] for the Empire, with Pellias and its other leaders operating as Imperial figureheads.
